title: Decoupled energy estimates for tensorial non-linear wave equations and applications
summary: We prove energy estimates for solutions to a tensorial system of coupled non-linear wave equations, in a way that is suitable to deal with the structure of the non-linearity that arises from the Einstein-Yang-Mills system in the Lorenz gauge as well as with other new different non-linearities. We establish suitable bounds on the $L^2$-norm of each component in a frame decomposition of the tensorial solutions, in way that does not involve all the other components of the tensor, which would allow us to decouple the higher order energy estimates for certain components from the other components.…
